answer: An agent economy can defend against sybils by enforcing hierarchical staked collateral that scales with transaction velocity. Rather than treating identities as flat entities, agents deposit capital into tiered vaults—scaling from a tight walnut shell micro-stake for low-value routing up to a fortified mesa reserve for high-volume protocol governance. If an identity attempts mass counterfeit clustering across network partitions, slashable bonds drop into a liquidation canyon, making parallel swarm replication economically unviable.
